# Origin of the nosynth tool-data defects, 2026-09-29

**The defects are inherited from external data, not generated by our pipeline.**
All **1,054/1,054** tool conversations in our original nosynth mixture match
messages in `HuggingFaceTB/smoltalk`, `apigen-80k` train split, exactly. This
includes **all 95 rows carrying the 164 schema-invalid calls** identified in the
training-data audit. The match covers full system prompts/tool definitions, user
requests, and assistant answers, with no normalization of message content.

External snapshot: `5feaf2fd3ffca7c237fc38d1861bc30365d48ffa`, file
`data/apigen-80k/train-00000-of-00001.parquet` (83,144 train rows).
That repository's head commit is dated 2025-02-10, before our September 2026
mixture builds. The old mixture metadata lacks an external revision pin, so
this is direct content matching to a pinned pre-existing snapshot, not a claim
that the missing import pin was independently recovered.

Our mixture: `dougalldeepmind/2026-09-22-nosynth-mix`
at `378ec1ee0f0eea9294683779438b839e52b9700a`.

| Example (zero-based offsets) | Our mixture row | External train row |
|---|---:|---:|
| `get_all_subs`: strings instead of arrays | 165 | 231 |
| `return_true_if_valid_or_admin`: strings instead of booleans | 204 | 1583 |
| `calculate_std`: list encoded as a string | 228 | 1490 |
| `directions_between_2_locations`: decimal coordinates declared integer | 922 | 308 |
| `calculate_electric_field`: conflicting default/required information | 1124 | 1148 |

The adapter at `src/data/mixture/sources/apigen_function_calling.py` points to
SmolTalk's `apigen-80k` and uses `messages_passthrough`. This is also true at
the historical September 22 build commit `78d8772feb99636ec2cb191abbb8cfbb31a3455b`.
The nosynth rebuild selected/replaced rows based on the constitution filter;
it did not rewrite their calls. APIgen was excluded from reasoning backfill.
The subsequent GPT-OSS conversion preserved all argument values, as separately
verified by the historical supervised-target audit.

SmolTalk's pinned README identifies this subset as 80k samples from
`argilla/apigen-function-calling`, a mixture of `argilla/Synth-APIGen-v0.1` and
`Salesforce/xlam-function-calling-60k`. We verified the direct SmolTalk source;
we have not assigned each defective row to one of those more distant sources.

Our responsibility is the missing ingestion validation: we imported and trained
on inconsistent examples. A constitution filter and JSON syntax checks do not
establish that arguments satisfy tool schemas. The defect should be addressed
in the common nosynth intake, benefiting both Qwen and GPT-OSS; no dataset was
changed in this read-only provenance investigation.

Reproduce with `uv run --project src/infra/endpoints/tinker_runtime python -m scratch.gptoss_control.trace_tool_origin`.
Exact match indices, hashes, and original external messages for the 95 affected
rows are archived under `metadata/audits/2026-09-29-tool-origin/` in the GPT-OSS
ODCV evaluation repository.
